name: icloud-bridge
description: A local macOS MCP bridge for Apple Calendar and Reminders.

interface.shortDescription: Use local Apple Calendar and Reminders.
interface.longDescription: iCloud Bridge connects Codex and ChatGPT desktop to the Calendar and Reminders data already on this Mac. It runs locally and does not store Apple data or credentials.
defaultPrompt: List my reminder lists and unfinished reminders.
Create a reminder in my default list.
